site.tagline: Notes on everything I taught myself
site.description: I taught myself English, then taught myself to program — and got a lot wrong before finding what suited me. These are my notes: where I got stuck, what got me unstuck, and the tools I used.
site.keywords: learn English on your own, self-study English, comprehensible input, immersion, Anki, self-taught programming
site.authorBio: I taught myself English, then taught myself to program, and I write down every place I got stuck so the next person does not lose ten years to it.
